claims.text: Normalize keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation; used alone or with topical corticosteroids,
claims.quote: Vitamin D3 analogs (eg, calcipotriol [calcipotriene], calcitriol) are topical medications that induce normal keratinocyte proliferation and differentiation; they can be used alone or in combination with topical glucocorticoids.

claims.text: and the combination works better than either alone (SORT A).
claims.quote: The combination of corticosteroids and vitamin D analogues performed better than either agent alone.44 | | A

claims.text: Some clinicians use calcipotriol on weekdays and the steroid on weekends
claims.quote: Some clinicians have patients apply calcipotriol on weekdays and glucocorticoids on weekends.

claims.text: Mild to moderate scalp psoriasis: calcipotriene foam or calcipotriene/betamethasone dipropionate gel for four to 12 weeks (SORT A)
claims.quote: Calcipotriene foam and calcipotriene/betamethasone dipropionate gel should be used for four to 12 weeks for the treatment of mild to moderate scalp psoriasis.51–53 | | A
